name: Pad grapao

items.name: Chicken, thigh, lean, raw
items.label: Chicken thigh, hand chopped to a rough mince

method: Have the rice cooked and hot before you start. The stir fry takes four minutes and won't wait for you.
Mix the light soy, oyster, dark soy, sugar and water in a small bowl. Set it next to the pan.
Pound or chop the garlic and chilli together into a coarse paste. A mortar is better than a knife here, it releases more.
Get a wok or heavy frying pan very hot. Add the oil, then the garlic and chilli. Ten seconds, no more — fragrant, not browned.
Add the chicken. Spread it out and leave it 45 seconds to catch some colour, then break it up and stir fry until just cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Add the beans and the sauce mix. It will hiss and reduce. Toss for 60 to 90 seconds until it clings to the meat and there's only a spoonful of liquid left.
Kill the heat, throw in the basil and fold it through until it wilts. Basil goes bitter if you cook it.
Rice in the bowl, chicken over the top.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Rice down, cauliflower rice fried in the same pan first.

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: More rice for a session day, and a little more sauce so it isn't dry.

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: More chicken plus a fried egg. Sauce up by half or it tastes thin.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Double the beans and add snake bean or broccolini.

mods.name: More iron
mods.note: A big handful of spinach folded through at the very end, with the basil. The chilli and the lime you squeeze over help you absorb it.

add.name: Spinach, baby, fresh, raw
add.label: Baby spinach, folded through with the basil

name: Caramelised onion pasta with paprika chicken

items.name: Salt, table, iodised
items.label: Fine salt, for chicken and onions

items.name: Oil, olive
items.label: Olive oil, for the chicken and the onions

items.name: Onion, mature, brown skinned, peeled, raw
items.label: Brown onion, sliced 3 mm

method: Rub the chicken with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Leave it on the bench while you do the onions.

Heat half the oil in a wide pan over medium low. Add the onions and a pinch of salt. Stir to coat, then let them go 20 to 25 minutes, stirring every few minutes. If they catch, add a tablespoon of water and scrape the base. Collapsed and jammy, deep brown, not black.
Add the balsamic, stir 30 seconds until it disappears, then tip the onions into a bowl and wipe the pan.
Salt a pot of water and put the pasta on. Set a timer for one minute under the packet time.
Heat the rest of the oil over medium high. Chicken in, 5 to 6 minutes on the first side without moving it, 4 to 5 on the second, to 74°C. Rest 5 minutes.
Lift the pasta straight into the pan with the onions, 80 ml of pasta water and the cream. Medium heat, tossing hard for a minute.
Off the heat, add the parmesan in two goes, tossing between each. Glossy and coating. More pasta water if it looks tight.
Slice the chicken across the grain, lay it over the pasta, parsley on top.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Half the pasta, courgette ribbons tossed in at the end.

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: A bigger bowl for a hard day.

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: More chicken, and ricotta through the sauce in place of cream.

add.label: Ricotta, stirred through off the heat

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Wholemeal pasta and a handful of peas.

add.name: Pea, green, raw
add.label: Peas, in with the pasta for the last minute

mods.name: More calcium
mods.note: More parmesan, and ricotta through the sauce as well as the cream.

name: Dan dan mian

items.name: Tahini
items.label: Chinese sesame paste, or tahini, 1½ tbsp

items.name: Oil, sesame
items.label: Chilli oil, with the sediment, 2 tsp

items.name: Stock, liquid, all flavours, prepared
items.label: Chicken stock, or hot noodle water

items.name: Cabbage, Chinese (wombok), raw
items.label: Sui mi ya cai, rinsed and squeezed dry

items.name: Bok choy or pak choy, raw
items.label: Bok choy or gai lan, halved

method: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan for 60 seconds until you can smell them, then grind. Do this first, it makes the dish.

Whisk all the sauce ingredients together in the bowl you're going to eat from. It'll look split at first — keep going and it emulsifies to the texture of thin cream. A splash more stock if it's claggy.

Heat the oil in a wok over high. Pork in, press it flat and leave it 2 minutes to crust, then break it up and keep frying until properly browned and a bit crisp, 4 to 5 minutes. Don't rush this; soft mince makes a sad bowl.
Add the Shaoxing and dark soy, let it sizzle away, then the ya cai. One more minute. Off the heat.
Boil the noodles to packet time. Greens in for the last 60 seconds. Reserve 50 ml of the water before draining.
Noodles straight into the sauce bowl, greens on the side, pork over the top, then spring onion and peanuts.
Toss it all together yourself before the first mouthful. It's meant to be mixed, not layered.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Half the noodles, shredded wombok for the bulk.

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: A full nest and a half for a session day.

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: More pork and a soft boiled egg. Sauce up by a third.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Double the greens.

mods.name: More calcium
mods.note: Sesame paste is the quiet source here. More of it, more greens, and sesame seeds over the top.

name: Protein yoghurt bowl

items.name: Muesli, commercial, untoasted or natural, dried fruit & nuts
items.label: Granola

method: Put the yoghurt in a bowl. Add the protein powder and about two thirds of the milk. Stir until there are no dry pockets. Thick but still moving.
Add the psyllium and the rest of the milk. Stir fast — it starts gelling within seconds.
Leave it 5 minutes. The psyllium pulls in the rest of the liquid and the texture goes from gritty to smooth and pudding-like. Beat in another splash if it's stiffer than you like.
Blueberries and granola on top. Granola last, and eat it soon after or it softens.
Drink a glass of water with this. 10 g of psyllium needs it.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Less granola and fruit, flaked almonds for the crunch.

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: Oats stirred in and more fruit — an overnight version, made the night before.

add.name: Oats, rolled, uncooked
add.label: Rolled oats, stirred in at step 2

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: Double the yoghurt and a little more powder.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Chia as well as psyllium, and the liquid to carry it. Don't go past 20 g of husk and seed in one sitting unless you're used to it.

mods.name: More omega-3
mods.note: Chia and walnuts. Both are ALA rather than the long chain sort — useful, but not a substitute for oily fish.

name: Chicken breast wrap

items.name: Bread, flat wrap or tortilla, wholemeal, commercial
items.label: Wholemeal tortilla, 1 large

items.name: Onion, mature, red skinned, peeled, raw
items.label: Red onion, sliced thin

method: Butterfly the breast, or lay it under baking paper and flatten the thick end until it's an even 1.5 cm. Even thickness is the whole trick with breast.
Rub with the oil, then the cumin, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper.
Medium high pan, dry. Chicken in, 4 minutes, turn, 3 to 4 minutes more, to 72°C. Rest 5 minutes, then slice on an angle.
Mix the yoghurt, lemon juice and a pinch of garlic powder and salt for the dressing.
Warm the tortilla 20 seconds a side in the same pan. It stops it cracking when you roll.
Spread the dressing down the middle third, leaving 3 cm clear at each end. Lettuce, cucumber, tomato, onion, then the chicken, then the feta.
Fold the bottom up over the filling, fold both sides in, and roll away from you, keeping it tight.
Wrap the bottom half in baking paper and cut on the diagonal.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Cos leaves as cups instead of the tortilla.

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: More chicken, more dressing, more feta. You may need a second tortilla to get it closed.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Swap in a high fibre wrap and pile in more salad.

mods.name: More calcium
mods.note: More feta and a bigger dressing.

name: Chicken garden salad

items.name: Oil, olive
items.label: Olive oil, for cooking and for the dressing

items.name: Onion, mature, red skinned, peeled, raw
items.label: Red onion, paper thin

method: Flatten the breast to an even thickness, rub with 5 g of the oil, salt and pepper. Medium high pan, 4 minutes, turn, 3 to 4 minutes, to 72°C. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Soak the sliced onion in cold water for 10 minutes while you do everything else, then drain. It takes the harsh edge off.
Shake or whisk the rest of the oil with the lemon, mustard and honey until the mustard thickens it slightly.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, until they start popping. Tip them straight out or they'll keep cooking.
Leaves, tomato, cucumber, capsicum, carrot and drained onion in a big bowl. Dress and toss with your hands, gently, until every leaf has a shine.
Plate it, chicken over the top, seeds scattered last.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: Drop the carrot and the honey, add avocado. It is already low carb.

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: Freekeh or quinoa and roast pumpkin turn it into a proper dinner.

add.name: Pumpkin, kent/jap, peeled, fresh, baked, no added fat
add.label: Roast pumpkin

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: More chicken, a boiled egg and feta.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Chickpeas through the leaves.

mods.name: More iron
mods.note: Spinach through the leaves and chickpeas on top. The lemon and capsicum are already doing the vitamin C work that makes plant iron count.

name: Eggs and salmon on rye
method: Beat the eggs with a little salt until the whites and yolks are one colour, no more than that.
Slice the tomato, lay it on the plate, and season it now. Tomato needs salt to taste of anything.
Toast the rye.

Melt the butter in a non stick pan over low heat — not medium. Eggs in, and stir slowly with a spatula, pushing the set curds into the centre. Two to three minutes. Take it off while it still looks slightly underdone; it keeps cooking on the plate.
Spread the cottage cheese on the toast, tomato over it, then the eggs.
Drape the salmon over the top, then the capers, dill and chives. Squeeze the lemon over and finish with pepper.

mods.name: Less carbs
mods.note: One slice of rye, the rest on wilted spinach.

add.name: Spinach, fresh, boiled, microwaved or steamed, drained
add.label: Spinach, wilted

mods.name: More carbs
mods.note: A third slice and a little honey on the side for a session morning.

mods.name: More protein
mods.note: One whole egg plus liquid egg white, more salmon and cottage cheese.

mods.name: More fibre
mods.note: Wholegrain rye and avocado under the eggs.

mods.name: More omega-3
mods.note: More salmon. This is the long chain sort, which is the one that is hard to get anywhere else.
